'''Zereldspidar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] who became a charismatic, although evil, dictator of the Snivvian [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Cadomai Prime/Legends|Cadomai Prime]]. The product of a rare Snivvian genetic defect that resulted in male twin births, Zereldspidar developed a personality disorder which manifested itself in sociopathic behavior. After rising to power on Cadomai, he was eventually ousted by the forces of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
